label: There are coherent finite typed models with an actually existing subject whose esse and essence…
paraphrase: There are coherent finite typed models with an actually existing subject whose esse and essence are distinct: (i) no external efficient cause while the no-essential-self-cause premise holds and the cause-dichotomy premise fails; (ii) no external cause while the dichotomy holds and the no-self-cause premise fails; (iii) a model where both premises and the external-cause conclusion hold for an actual subject. These are logical interpretation controls, not established metaphysical possibilities.
